text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P12345 - billing.metering.emitter_pending_count_high - EU region. Alert: aggregated pending emit count > threshold for >6m, spikes started after 02:32 UTC deploy. Triggering alerting runbook. Paging @oncall.

sandeep: ack - I'm oncall, joining call now. marking as P1. Quick check: is this affecting historical backfill or only live emits?

maya: looks like live emits primarily. I pulled metrics from emitter-v2 and window-aggregator in eu-west-1: pending_window_count jumped and window_flush latency spiked. I can see recent deploy (image: emitter-v2:2026-03-15-abc123) at 02:32. Suspect KV-cache TTL misalignment with new aggregator behavior.

kevin: I'm seeing a pattern where some account keys never hit KV cache and get deferred into a pending queue that isn't batched correctly. Example from logs:
```
[WARN] window-aggregator: flush-skip key=acct-0x4f ttl=0.0003 kvcache_miss=true pending_count=4200
[ERROR] emitter: flush-failed key=acct-0x7b reason=partial-window mismatch
```

lindsey: pinging billing-eng to confirm whether overage flags were emitted downstream. @billing-eng

billing-eng: confirmed: the metering pipeline ingested a small number of delayed events and our overage-detector emitted transient overage flags for ~180 accounts. Charges were NOT finalized (billing writeout is gated), but CS sees UI flags and customers are getting alerts.

alice-cs: already seeing 6 tickets from EU customers about "unexpected overage" notifications. We should prepare a customer-safe message template before we do any backfill replay to avoid confusion.

sandeep: immediate mitigation plan:
- roll back emitter-v2 and aggregator to previous stable images (pre-02:32) in eu-west-1
- restart emitter pods with graceful drains to let in-flight batches finish
- run a targeted replay for keys where pending_count > 1000
- hold billing writeouts for EU for next 2 hours until reconciliation
I'll take lead on rollback. kevin please prepare replay job.

kevin: preparing rollback PR and replay script. quick check commands I'm going to run:
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=window-aggregator -o wide
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/window-aggregator --to-revision=3
/opt/tools/replay.sh --since=2026-03-15T02:00Z --filter-region=eu-west-1 --min-pending=100
```
I'll also snapshot the pending queue:
```
curl -s http://window-aggregator.eu:8080/debug/pending | jq '.counts | {top: .[0:10]}'
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: initiating rollback of deployment/window-aggregator -> revision 3. ETA ~2m. :gear:

sandeep: noted — please keep me posted. Lindsey, hold customer comms until we confirm scope and whether flags clear automatically after replay.

ops-bot: rollback complete on window-aggregator (deploy revision 3). emitter-v2 rollback scheduled next (starting in 30s).

kevin: started replay for 1.2k affected keys (filter matched ~1.2k unique acct ids). Doing it in small chunks to avoid double-emits. Script logs:
```
INFO replay: batch 1/60 accounts=20 duration=12s
INFO replay: batch 30/60 accounts=20 duration=10s
WARN replay: duplicate-event-detected acct=acct-0x4f skipping
```

billing-eng: paused billing writeout for eu-west-1 at 1719012000 (internal hold). Will not commit charges until reconciliation complete. Overage flags are pinned to UI but we can clear programmatically after reconciliation.

alice-cs: draft message ready (do not send until final):
```
Subject: Temporary metering alert in EU region — no charges applied
Hi — We observed transient usage flags in the dashboard for some EU accounts between 02:30–03:20 UTC. We are reconciling data and no charges will be applied while this is investigated. We will follow up when reconciliation is complete.
```

maya: preliminary root cause: deploy introduced a TTL-scaling change in emitter's KV cache client (ttlSeconds default went to 0 for cold keys when migrating to new client). That caused the aggregator to treat many keys as cache-misses which prevented proper prefix batching. When batching fails, pending window entries accumulate and get emitted later causing delayed events and transient overage detection.

lindsey: mitigation checklist going forward (postmortem TODO):
- revert KV client default TTL to previous sane value
- add canary gating for emitter->aggregator changes in eu region for 24h with traffic split
- add alert for 'pending_window_age > 5m' per region (not just count)
- add guard in billing pipeline to suppress UI overage flags until writeout commit

sandeep: oncall handoff: I need to step off in 15m. kevin, will you take second-shift and finish reconciliation? If any writeouts are unblocked, don't commit until I confirm.

kevin: taking over. I will monitor replay, watch for duplicate-emits, and coordinate with billing-eng for final writeout. ping me @kevin if anything urgent.

ops-bot: replay job completed successfully. replayed ~11k events into ingestion with 0.3% duplicates skipped. pending_window_count in eu-west-1 now stable < 20.

billing-eng: performed reconciliation dry-run; delta < 0.6% for affected accounts. Preparing final commit window in 30m. Will post commit log before unhold.

alice-cs: queued the customer message to go out after final commit confirming no charges and apology. Template approved by product.

lindsey: logging action items to postmortem: config rollback (done), KV-ttl fix (PR #4567), canary rollout gates, billing UI guard. Schedule SEV debrief tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

kevin: final note: root cause patch ready, low-risk, will merge after billing commit. I'll post final status here once writeout completes.

ops-bot: Incident P12345: RESOLVED - monitoring normal. Incident review scheduled: 2026-03-16 10:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

sandeep: thanks everyone for quick coordination. Closing thread, will follow up in postmortem with timing and playbook updates.
